notes: result_type is observation because the title says "Observation"; no significance is quoted in the abstract.

summary.plain: BESII saw a narrow bump near the combined rest mass of the proton and antiproton, in the mass spectrum of proton-antiproton pairs from decays of J/psi particles that emit a photon. Its mass and width were not consistent with any known meson resonance.
summary.technical: BES: narrow enhancement near 2m_p in the invariant-mass spectrum of p p̄ pairs from radiative J/ψ → γ p p̄ decays; fit with an S- or P-wave Breit-Wigner function; for the S-wave fit the peak mass is below the 2m_p threshold and the full width is less than 30 MeV; 'not consistent with the properties of any known meson resonance'.

title: Observation of a near-threshold enhancement in th p pbar mass spectrum from radiative J/psi-->gamma p pbar decays
why_it_matters: The abstract states that the mass and width values are not consistent with the properties of any known meson resonance.
